summary: ABVC BioPharma filed an 8-K reporting completion of the spin-off of its subsidiary BioKey (Cayman), Inc. via a pro-rata dividend of 15% of BioKey ordinary shares to ABVC stockholders. Stockholders received 0.169464 BioKey ordinary share per ABVC share held as of July 24, 2026 record date; 4,500,390 ordinary shares distributed effective August 21, 2026. Following the distribution, ABVC retains approximately 85% controlling interest in BioKey, which became an independent Exchange Act reporting company via Form 10 effective June 25, 2026. The separation and distribution occur under a Separation and Distribution Agreement dated June 22, 2026. What to watch: post-spin valuation of BioKey shares and any tax implications for distributing shareholders.
